purpose: Validates an adverse action notice against Reg B §1002.9 completeness requirements: reason count (max 4), prohibited vague reason codes (CFPB Circulars 2022-03/2023-03), required content fields (creditor name, date, statement of rights), and FCRA §615(a) rights disclosure when a credit score was used. Outputs compliance_score (0-100), violation list, and a remediation checklist. Reg B 12 CFR §1002.9, ECOA 15 USC §1691, FCRA §615(a).
